categories.list.description: List categories via POST /v1/categories/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_CATEGORIES.

boardID.description: Filter categories by this board ID.

limit.description: Number of categories to return. Defaults to 10. Max 10000.

skip.description: Number of categories to skip. Defaults to 0.

categories.list.title: List categories

comments.create.description: Create a portal comment on a post via POST /v1/comments/create. Maps to CANNY_CREATE_COMMENT.

authorID.description: Canny user ID of the comment author.

createdAt.description: Original ISO 8601 created timestamp when migrating comments.

imageURLs.description: Image URLs attached to the comment.

internal.description: Internal-only comment. Author must be a company member.

parentID.description: Parent comment ID when this comment is a reply.

postID.description: Canny post ID to comment on.

shouldNotifyVoters.description: Whether to email post voters. Defaults to false.

value.description: Comment text, up to 2500 characters. Required if imageURLs is empty.

comments.create.title: Create comment

comments.delete.description: Delete a portal comment via POST /v1/comments/delete. Maps to CANNY_DELETE_COMMENT.

commentID.description: Unique identifier of the comment to delete.

comments.delete.title: Delete comment

comments.list.description: List portal comments via POST /v2/comments/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_COMMENTS. Official pagination uses cursor; skip is accepted when provided.

companyID.description: Only comments from users linked to this company.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Number of comments to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

skip.description: Number of comments to skip. Composio alias; official v2 uses cursor.

comments.list.title: List comments

companies.list.description: List companies via POST /v2/companies/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_COMPANIES.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

search.description: Search by company name. Disables cursor pagination.

segment.description: URL name of the segment to filter by.

companies.list.title: List companies

entries.create.description: Create and optionally publish a changelog entry via POST /v1/entries/create. Maps to CANNY_CREATE_CHANGELOG_ENTRY.

details.description: Markdown details of the changelog entry.

labelIDs.description: Label IDs to assign to the entry.

notify.description: If publishing immediately, whether to email users. Defaults to false.

postIDs.description: Post IDs to link to the entry.

published.description: Whether to publish immediately. Defaults to false.

publishedOn.description: ISO 8601 publish date in the past when published is true.

entries.create.title: Create changelog entry

healthcheck.description: Validate the Canny API key with POST /v1/boards/list.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

opportunities.list.description: List opportunities linked to posts via POST /v1/opportunities/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_OPPORTUNITIES.

limit.description: Number of opportunities to return. Defaults to 10.

skip.description: Number of opportunities to skip. Defaults to 0.

opportunities.list.title: List opportunities

posts.add_tag.description: Add an existing tag to a Canny post via POST /v1/posts/add_tag. Maps to CANNY_ADD_POST_TAG.

postID.description: Unique identifier of the post to which the tag will be added.

tagID.description: Unique identifier of the tag to add to the post.

posts.add_tag.title: Add post tag

posts.change_status.description: Change a post's workflow status via POST /v1/posts/change_status. Maps to CANNY_CHANGE_POST_STATUS.

changerID.description: Unique identifier of the admin recording the status change.

commentImageURLs.description: Optional image URLs attached to the status-change comment.

commentValue.description: Optional comment shown in the post activity feed.

postID.description: Unique identifier of the post whose status will be changed.

shouldNotifyVoters.description: Whether non-admin voters should be notified. Defaults to false.

status.description: New status, e.g. open, under review, planned, in progress, complete, closed, or a custom status.

posts.create.description: Create a feedback post on a board via POST /v1/posts/create. Maps to CANNY_CREATE_POST.

authorID.description: Canny user ID of the post author.

boardID.description: Board ID where the post will be created.

byID.description: Admin ID creating the post on behalf of the author.

createdAt.description: Original ISO 8601 created timestamp when migrating posts.

etaPublic.description: Whether the ETA is visible to all users.

imageURLs.description: Image URLs attached to the post.

ownerID.description: User ID responsible for completing the work.

posts.create.title: Create post

posts.delete.description: Permanently delete a post via POST /v1/posts/delete. Maps to CANNY_DELETE_POST.

postID.description: Unique identifier of the post to delete.

posts.get.description: Retrieve a Canny post by ID.
posts.get.title: Get Post

posts.list.description: List Canny posts with bounded pagination.

authorID.description: Only fetch posts by this author ID.

companyID.description: Only fetch posts created by users linked to this company identifier.

search.description: Search query to filter posts by title or details.

sort.description: Order to fetch posts. relevance requires search.

status.description: Comma-separated list of statuses to filter by.

tagIDs.description: Only fetch posts tagged with at least one of these tag IDs.

posts.list.title: List Posts

posts.update.description: Update an existing post via POST /v1/posts/update. Maps to CANNY_UPDATE_POST.

customFields.description: Custom fields to set on the post.

eta.description: Estimated completion as MM/YYYY, or null to clear.

etaPublic.description: Whether the ETA is visible to end-users.

imageURLs.description: Image URLs attached to the post.

postID.description: Unique identifier of the post to update.

posts.update.title: Update post

tags.create.description: Create a tag on a board via POST /v1/tags/create. Maps to CANNY_CREATE_TAG.

boardID.description: Board ID the tag should be created for.

tags.create.title: Create tag

tags.get.description: Retrieve a tag by ID via POST /v1/tags/retrieve. Maps to CANNY_RETRIEVE_TAG.

id.description: Unique identifier of the tag to retrieve.

tags.list.description: List tags via POST /v1/tags/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_TAGS.

users.create_or_update.description: Create a user or update an existing one via POST /v1/users/create_or_update. Maps to CANNY_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_USER. Provide at least one of email, userID, or id.

avatarURL.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

companies.description: Companies to associate with the user. Associating requires userID.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the company was created.

monthlySpend.description: Monthly spend associated with the company.

created.description: ISO 8601 date the user was created in your system.

customFields.description: Custom fields (keys 0-30 chars; string values <200 chars).

email.description: User email. One of email, userID, or id is required.

id.description: Existing Canny user ID when updating.

userID.description: Your application's unique identifier for the user.

users.create_or_update.title: Create or update user

users.delete.description: Delete a user and their comments and votes via POST /v1/users/delete. Maps to CANNY_DELETE_USER.
users.delete.title: Delete user

users.get.description: Retrieve a user via POST /v1/users/retrieve. Maps to CANNY_RETRIEVE_USER. Provide exactly one of id, userID, or email.

userID.description: Your application's unique identifier for the user.

users.get.title: Retrieve user

users.list.description: List workspace users via POST /v2/users/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_USERS.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

users.list.title: List users

votes.create.description: Create a vote on a post via POST /v1/votes/create. Maps to CANNY_CREATE_VOTE.

byID.description: Admin ID casting the vote on behalf of the voter.

createdAt.description: Original ISO 8601 created timestamp when migrating votes.

votePriority.description: Vote priority: 0 (Nice to have), 10 (Important), or 20 (Must have).

votes.create.title: Create vote

votes.delete.description: Remove a user's vote from a post via POST /v1/votes/delete. Maps to CANNY_DELETE_VOTE.

postID.description: Post ID from which the vote will be removed.

voterID.description: User ID whose vote is being removed.

votes.delete.title: Delete vote

votes.list.description: List votes via POST /v2/votes/list. Maps to CANNY_LIST_VOTES. Composio voterID is sent as official userID.

companyID.description: Filter votes by users linked to this company.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Number of votes to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

skip.description: Number of votes to skip. Composio alias; official v2 uses cursor.

voterID.description: Filter votes by voter. Mapped to official userID.

votes.list.title: List votes

incidents.affectedData: 21bitcoin support-system contacts (names, emails, phones, DOB, device metadata, account status/balance stored in support, first message/subject). Bitcoin balances and KYC were not in scope per 21bitcoin.
incidents.affectedProduct: Canny (feedback tool) Intercom integration used by 21bitcoin
incidents.remediation: 21bitcoin says Canny cut the Intercom connection the same day and invalidated the stolen key. 21bitcoin rotated related credentials. No Canny-authored public incident report located.
incidents.residualRisk: Unknown whether Canny secret API keys (this recipe's credential) were in the attack scope. Current unresolved credible issue; not waived as historical.
incidents.status: unresolved: Canny public RCA not found as of 2026-09-13; 21bitcoin requested forensic report and root-cause analysis from Canny

remainingGates: unresolved Canny 2026-08-28 incident: 21bitcoin reports Canny was targeted and an Intercom integration access key was stolen; Canny has not published a public RCA as of 2026-09-13
research.searchCoverage: Official Canny API is POST JSON with apiKey in the body. POST /v1/boards/list is the cheap authenticated board list used by the pinned credential validator. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found 21bitcoin's 2026-09-02 disclosure that Canny was targeted on 2026-08-28 and an Intercom integration access key was stolen. Canny has not published a public RCA. HOLD, not APPROVED.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage. This August 2026 Canny incident is current and is not treated as waived history.

selection.ownership: Canny, a Canadian product-feedback SaaS (Victoria, BC) in the Tiny portfolio. Reviewed edition is the public international API at https://canny.io/api, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Canny API (POST JSON to https://canny.io/api with apiKey body field, POST /v1/boards/list, /v1/boards/retrieve, /v1/posts/list, /v1/posts/retrieve), company settings secret key, Canadian/Tiny identity, and dated incident search for Canny security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. 21bitcoin disclosed on 2026-09-02 that Canny was targeted on 2026-08-28 and an Intercom integration access key was stolen. Canny has not published a public RCA as of 2026-09-13. This is treated as an unresolved current issue, not a historical waived incident.
